ops.en: THE GRAIN SEEN. ki yesh SHEVER be-mitzrayim — the shever-word (grain-for-sale) that closed gen_64 (41:56-57, the sell-verb) is the first fact of the new span: the door the world walked through now opens for the brothers. lama titrau — the reproach that starts the descent.

THE WORD FOR GRAIN IS READ TWICE, AND THE TRANSLATION FLATTENS THE SECOND READING. The chain hears the grain-word also as HOPE - his hope was in Egypt, and that hope was his son - mapping the two halves of the decree onto one noun. Onkelos writes one commodity word throughout the descent, so the pun the chain builds on is precisely what the buffer removes. Both members recorded; neither corrected.…

THE GO-DOWN COMMAND. REDU shamah ve-shivru lanu mi-sham — Jacob's imperative pair pushed as one demand; ve-nichye ve-lo namut — the live-and-not-die clause is its stated stake (the same clause will close the Judah-speech at 43:8). The bet of ba-mitzrayim DAGESHED per MS (checked [G65-12]); ve-nichye with the yod in segol (MS, asserted).

A GROCERY INSTRUCTION READ AS A TERM OF YEARS [claim G65-22]. The imperative's letter-value is taken as 210 - the years of the servitude - so the command that sends them for food announces the length of the exile it begins. Arithmetic checked on our own consonants: two hundred, four, and six, exactly 210. The father who says it is, by this block's own standing state, a man from whom the prophetic …

THE DESCENT. va-yerdu ACHEI YOSEF asara — the go-down demand discharges immediately, and the narrator counts the goers as 'the brothers of JOSEPH' (not 'the sons of Jacob'): ten, the letter already subtracting the one they sold. MI-mitzrayim written with the from-preposition in the Aspamia codex and Rabbenu Gershom's book against the in-Egypt copies — SNAPSHOT with the precise books (checked [G65-…

THE REDUNDANT COUNT IS READ AS A DIVISION OF PURPOSE [claim G65-23 context]. 'TEN of Joseph's brothers went down' - the count is superfluous, so it is made to carry a proportion: nine parts of the journey were the search for a brother and one part was grain. The instruction that framed it is read the same way - carry no bread and no coins, and do not all enter by one gate, against the evil eye. [f…

THE WITHHELD SON [G65-02]. ve-et BINYAMIN — written FULL (yod between the mem and the nun): the Ramah counts SEVEN such fulls in the Torah, and the census is EXACT — 35:18 (the naming), here, 43:14, 43:16, 43:29, 45:12, 49:27 (the blessing): the full spellings ride the naming, the guarding, the releasing, the seeing, the kissing, and the blessing [VERIFIED: manifest G65-02]. pen yiqraenu ASON — th…

A TRANSLATOR'S CHOICE IN A FATHER'S FEAR IS A DECISION ABOUT A CAPITAL STATUTE [claim G65-21, machine-checked]. Onkelos renders the harm-word as DEATH at both seats in this block. Machine-checked across the whole Torah: the word stands at EXACTLY FIVE SEATS - three in this parashah's own units, and the other two in the miscarriage law, where the entire penalty structure turns on whether that harm …

AMONG THE COMERS. be-tokh ha-baim — the sons of Israel enter as anonymous traffic inside gen_64's closing fact (all the earth came, 41:57): the machine reads 42:5 as the world-demand's local instance.

AN INSTITUTION OF COMMUNAL PRAYER RESTING ON A GRAIN ITINERARY [claim G65-23]. Ten men came AMONG those who came, and from that clause the requirement of ten for matters of sanctity is derived - argued by equal-decree three separate ways, then corrected by a fourth master, since 'among' alone would admit far more than ten, so the derivation is pinned to the phrase 'sons of Israel' itself. The coun…

THE BOWING [gen_60 ARMED, DISCHARGED]. va-yavou achei yosef va- YISHTACHAVU lo apayim artza — the sheaves-dream (37:7, its open question logged in gen_60) lands its first fulfillment: the brothers bow with their faces to the ground before the brother they stripped; the Kitzur reads the bowing-phrase by letter-count: 'HERE THE DREAM WAS FULFILLED' (named) — and the bow-word is JOINED to 'to him' by…

THE RECOGNITION IS GIVEN A MECHANISM INSTEAD OF A COINCIDENCE [claim G65-25]. No slave may enter; no man with two donkeys, and no driver moving grain between places; and no entry without registering one's own name, one's father's and one's grandfather's - with the viceroy's elder son collecting the notes. The search apparatus is built into the relief program, so the brothers are found by administr…

THE RECOGNIZE-PAIR [gen_60 ARMED]. va-yakirem va-YITNAKER — the recognize-verb and its own reflexive negation in one breath: the root of the coat's haker-na (37:32, the two-unit crown) now conjugated by its victim. And the verse writes the TO-THEM word TWICE: aleHEM (idx6) FULL with the yod — the Hilleli copy lean, the Yerushalmi and ALL precise books full, one of the Masorah's seventeen fulls, SN…

THE BLOCK'S LOAD-BEARING DISAGREEMENT, CARRIED UNRESOLVED [claim G65-26]. The chain reads the verb exactly as written - he became like a stranger. Onkelos writes that he CONSIDERED WHAT HE SHOULD SAY to them. The choice decides whether every operator downstream models a deception or a calculated speech act, and the two members of the declared reading genuinely disagree, so neither is promoted. [fo…

THE ASYMMETRY [G65-11]. ve-hem lo HIKIRUHU — the not-recognized form stands ONCE in the Torah [VERIFIED: manifest G65-11]; the Masorah pairs it with Job's friends (Job 2:12, named): there suffering changed a man past knowing, here elevation — the slave became the governor (the Kitzur's own reading, named).

AN ASYMMETRY GIVEN A PHYSICAL CAUSE AND A MORAL ONE, BOTH KEPT [claim G65-27]. Morally: he knew them when they fell into his hands; they did not know him when he fell into theirs. Materially: he left them BEARDED and left them BEARDLESS. The Rabbis' answer supplies the machine a concrete variable, and the moral answer is not thereby discarded. [folded shape: recorded dispute]

THE REMEMBERING [gen_60 ARMED, DISCHARGED]. va-YIZKOR yosef et ha- CHALOMOT — the remember-verb whose failure opened gen_64 (40:23 'did not remember') and whose repair crowned it (41:9 'I mention today') now turns in Joseph's own mouth: he remembers THE DREAMS — gen_60's two open questions step onto the board mid-fulfillment. meraglim atem — the spy-charge, the gimel dageshed in every token of the…

A DIFFERENT CRIME IS CHARGED IN THE TRANSLATION [claim G65-30]. The idiom of shameful exposure becomes THE BREACH - the weak or defective part - at both seats. They are accused of scouting where the fortifications fail, not of shaming the country. The accusation the unit models is a military one. [folded shape: dual-track translation]
THE DENIAL. lo adoni — the brothers call the stripped brother 'my lord'; avadekha 'your servants' — the sheaves-dream's vocabulary volunteered by its deniers (37:8 'will you rule over us?').

THE SHORT WE [G65-07]. bene ish echad NACHNU — the clipped we-form (nachnu, not anachnu) stands exactly TWICE in the Torah: here and the Reubenite war-pledge 'we will cross armed' (Num 32:32) [VERIFIED: manifest G65-07]; the Masorah's third is Lamentations' 'we have transgressed' (Lam 3:42, named) — the Kitzur reads all three into one speech (armed to kill, and guilty). And the Kitzur hears the cl…
THE CHARGE HELD. lo ki — Joseph refuses the denial flat; the nakedness-phrase repeats verbatim: the interrogation's fixed pivot.

THE ACCOUNTING. shenem asar avadekha — twelve counted to the man who makes them twelve; ve-ha-echad ENENNU — 'the one is not': the is-not word (enennu) enters the span here and will toll through Jacob's lament (42:36, twice) and Reuben's report (42:32).
THE FORMALIZATION. hu asher dibarti — Joseph seals the charge as a standing accusation: the test that follows is its trial procedure.

THE TEST-CLAUSE. be-zot TIBACHENU chei faro — the examine-verb with the court-oath 'by Pharaoh's life' (twice in this speech, 42:15/16: the man who deflected to God before the throne swears by the king to his brothers — the mask's own grammar); ki im be-vo achikhem ha- qaton — the coming-of-the-youngest condition that will drive the next two units; the Kitzur counts the coming-word's letters as el…

THE OATH IS CLASSIFIED BY THE CHAIN AS INSINCERE [claim G65-27]. 'By Pharaoh's life' is named as his false-oath formula, with the widow-and-goat parable given as its type. The interrogation around it is priced: he raised the sale figure back at them until they answered - for that we came down, to kill or be killed. The tradition marks its own protagonist's oath as false and keeps the mark. [folded…

THE FIRST PLAN. SHILCHU mikem echad — send ONE, the nine stay bound: pushed as a demand and NEVER satisfied — the third day revises it into its mirror (one stays, nine go, 42:19), and the letter leaves this push on the queue: a demand superseded by its own author, the span's first dead-open (the machine's record of Joseph's softening — or of the interpreter's arithmetic: nine bound men buy no grai…

THE CUSTODY. va-yeesof otam el MISHMAR — the watch-word of gen_63's prison (40:3-4, the cupbearer's mishmar) now holds the ten; the Kitzur counts the three days against the three deeds done to the dreamer — stripped, cast, sold (named): measure begun for measure.

THE REVISION. ba-yom ha-shelishi ZOT ASU vi-chyu — the third-day turn (the letter's own revision-day: on the third day Abraham saw the place, 22:4): the first plan inverts — one binds, nine go. et ha-Elohim ani yare — the governor of Egypt hands the brothers the fear-of-God formula (the corpus last heard it from Abraham at Gerar, 20:11, as what Sarah's takers lacked): the mask names the Name and s…

A STANDING CANON PATTERN FIRES ON THIS VERSE [claim G65-32]. The third-day census counts this clause as a named member beside the mountain, the revelation, the prophet in the fish, the queen's fast and the clause read to resurrection - the rule being that the righteous are not left in distress past three days. Onkelos buffers the same verse's fear-of-God into reverence from before the LORD, on the…

THE MECHANICS. achikhem ECHAD yeaser — one for nine against the first plan's nine for one; shever RAAVON batekhem — the famine-of- your-houses phrase the brothers will carry back verbatim (42:33): the revision is built to be quotable.

THE CARRYING DEMAND. ve-et achikhem ha-QATON taviu elai — the bring- the-youngest demand: pushed here and left OPEN at the span's end — the hook the next unit hangs on (43:15 brings Benjamin down; the standing before Joseph at 43:26 is the satisfaction verse-in- waiting). ve-yeamnu divrekhem — the confirm-verb (amen's root) as the trial's stake.

THE RECEIPT. va-yaasu KHEN — the letter's own compliance-clause (the ken-receipt, the creation-week's grammar) pops the third-day plan the same speech that pushed it: agreed before it is executed — the binding lands at 42:24, the going at 42:26, but the KEN stands here.

THE CONFESSION. aval ASHEMIM anachnu — the guilt-word of the Leviticus ledger (lev_04's asham) spoken by laymen over a sale; be- HITCHANENO elenu — the pleading: gen_60's pit-scene narrated NO plea (37:23-24 stripped, cast, sat to eat) — the letter held the scene twenty-two years and releases it in the guilty men's own mouths: the machine files the retro-fact as the span's largest delta.

THEIR OWN WORDS ARE THE COURT RECORD [claim G65-28]. The boy at seventeen pleading at each brother's feet unheeded is what their confession quotes back at themselves. Onkelos renders 'we did not HEAR him' as we did not ACCEPT him, at this verse and at the elder's rebuke - hearing read as compliance, which is what the guilt is actually about. Chain and translation converge on the same clause from o…

THE CITATION. HALO amarti alekhem — Reuben quotes his own gen_60 demands (37:21-22, the three LET-NOTs still open on the corpus queue): the machine's first witness citing his own unpopped push; damo hine NIDRASH — the require-verb of the blood-reckoning handler (9:5, edrosh: gen_21's standing law) invoked by a layman against himself. halo written FULL per the Masorah (asserted [G65-12]).

THE INTERPRETER. ki ha-MELITZ benotam — the go-between word (its one Torah token): the man who 'hears a dream to interpret it' (41:15) listens to a confession through an interpreter he does not need: the mask's most expensive prop.

THE MAN THEY SPEAK FREELY IN FRONT OF IS THE VICEROY'S CHILD [claim G65-28]. The standing reading names the interpreter, and with the name the whole scene changes register: the brothers' unguarded speech is being carried by family. A forward seat promised at the sale block, occupied by the verse that block named. [folded shape: kept record]

THE FIRST WEEPING. va-yisov me-alehem va-YEVK — the weep-verb opens its Joseph-cycle series (it will return at 43:30, 45:2, 45:14-15, 46:29, 50:1, 50:17): the governor turns away to break; the mask holds by turning.

THE SOFT BINDING [G65-05; gen_60 ARMED (Simeon taken)]. va-yikach me-itam et SHIMON va-YEESOR oto le-enehem — the bind-verb with the alef in CHATAF SEGOL, the Masorah's one SOFT binding: its file counts three — this, and two hard-alef bindings of chariots: Joseph binding his chariot to meet his father (46:29, ARMED for gen_69) and Pharaoh binding his to chase the freed (Exod 14:6) [VERIFIED: manif…

AN INK ROW READ EIGHT CHAPTERS BACK NAMED THIS VERSE IN ADVANCE [claim G65-29]. The singular 'and they TOOK him' at the sale identified the brother who pushed him into the pit; here that same brother is taken and bound before their eyes. The choice of prisoner and the splitting of the pair - lest the two conspire - are read as deliberate. The corpus's own standing rebuke of that pair, that the swo…

THE RETURNED SILVER. u-le-hashiv KASPEHEM ish el sako — the governor returns the buying-silver unasked: the silver of the sale (37:28, twenty pieces) begins its long answer; va-yaas lahem KEN — the ken- clause again, the order receipted in the letter's compliance grammar.
THE GOING. va-yisu et SHIVRAM — the grain-word (shever) rides the donkeys toward the hungering houses: the second plan's go-clause (42:19) executed in the narration.

THE DISCOVERY. va-yar et KASPO ve-hine hu be-FI amtachto — the silver looks back from the bag's MOUTH (the letter gives the sack the organ of confession); ha-echad — 'the ONE' opened: the readings name him Levi (the emptied pair, named-only).

THE HEART GOES OUT. va-yetze LIBAM — the one heart of the ten leaves them; ma zot asa ELOHIM lanu — the brothers read the plot's author correctly and its plot wrong: the first naming of God in the span's mouth-space is a terror. The asa-Elohim pair with Yitro's verse (Exod 18:8-9's file) named by the Kitzur; the bet of be-amtachti RAFE per MS (asserted [G65-12]).

THE TRANSLATION SAYS WHICH CAPACITY LEAVES [claim G65-31]. 'Their HEART went out' becomes the UNDERSTANDING of their heart went out of them - the same specifying move the translator makes on the spirit in the previous block. Terror is converted into a statement about cognition, which is the form the unit's state operators can carry. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE TELLING [G65-06]. va-YAGIDU lo — the tell-verb FULL: the Hilleli copy lean, the Yerushalmi and every book full, and the Masorah rules full — for the Ramah counts the Torah's LEAN tellings as exactly TWO: the well-telling (26:32) and 'Joseph still lives' (45:26, ARMED for gen_68) — and the census verifies EXACT in-stream [VERIFIED: manifest G65-06]: the two lean tellings are a well found and a …

THE RETELLING. diber ha-ish ADONE ha-aretz itanu QASHOT — the harsh- word kept from 42:7, the charge softened to 'made us AS spies' (ka- meraglim — the kaf of comparison the interrogation never offered, under the lengthening-stroke per MS, named): the report's variance file opens exactly as gen_64's did (dream against retelling; deed against report).

THE QUOTED DENIAL. kenim anachnu — the honest-claim requoted with its verb shifted (hayinu for hayu): the letter lets the report drift one conjugation from the deed (42:11), and the machine files the drift.

THE CENSUS RETOLD. shenem asar anachnu ACHIM — the twelve restated to the father who counts them daily; ha-echad ENENNU — the is-not word's third toll. asar with the tevir stroke on the following we- word per MS (named [G65-12]).

THE DEMAND RETOLD. achikhem ha-echad HANICHU iti — the binding retold as a leaving (yeaser 42:19 becomes hanichu: the report softens the prison to a stay); QECHU va-LEKHU — the take-and-go pair the Kitzur's Masorah rides to Pharaoh's own qechu va-lekhu of the Exodus night (Exod 12:32, named): the go-word Egypt's two governors share.

THE ADDED CLAUSE. ve-et ha-aretz TISCHARU — 'and the land you shall trade': the retelling ADDS what the interrogation never said (as 41:21's lo-noda was the king's own addition): the brothers sell the deal to their father with a trading license the letter never recorded — the variance file's richest entry.

THE SEEN AND THE FEARED. va-YIRU et TZERUROT kaspehem... va-YIRAU — the see-verb and the fear-verb one letter apart (the letter's own pun filed); tzerorot written first-vav-lean second-vav-full per the Ramah and our books against the scroll-tikkun's variant (asserted [G65-12]); merikim with no paseq per MS (named).

A CHANGE OF STATE IN THE FATHER, READ OFF THE SILVER [claim G65-24]. When the money appears in the sacks he SUSPECTS THEM, and that suspicion is what feeds the refusal three verses later. 'All that BEFELL them' is read as weighing on them like beams. The chain models the refusal as the output of a state change rather than as temperament. [folded shape: kept record]

THE LAMENT [G65-02, G65-09]. oti SHIKALTEM — the bereave-verb Jacob will hand back at 43:14 (ka-asher shakholti shakhalti); yosef ENENNU ve-shimon ENENNU — the is-not word twice in the mourner's mouth; ve- et BINYAMIN — written LEAN here (against 42:4's full: the chapter carries both spellings of the son, the guarded full and the demanded lean; asserted under G65-02's census). alai hayu KHULANA — …

THE PLEDGE. TENA oto al yadi — Reuben's give-him imperative pushed: the man whose gen_60 demands still stand open pushes again, staking his own two sons; TAMIT — the you-may-kill form ONCE in the Torah [VERIFIED: manifest G65-10]; the reading tradition rides the two- sons clause into Datan and Aviram (named). The push meets its answer in the next verse — a refusal, not a receipt.

THE REFUSAL [G65-08]. lo YERED beni imakhem — Jacob refuses the pledge flat: Reuben's demand stays OPEN on the queue (dead-by- refusal, the shikhva-imi class) — and the next unit will watch hunger overturn the refusal itself (43:13-14). ki achiv MET — the father states as fact what no verse told him: the machine files the claim-without-source. ve-horadtem et SEVATI — the gray-hair word FULL with i…

A GENERAL RULE ABOUT EXPOSURE MINTED FROM A SENTENCE OF GRIEF [claim G65-24]. 'Lest disaster befall him ON THE WAY you go' is pressed - and in the house it could not? - yielding the standing rule that the accuser accuses only in a time of danger. The obligation to produce twelve tribes is read as resting on the speaker personally; the elder's offer of his two sons is dismissed outright - are your …
